thaanu hithabodhavishayamai janulanu heccharinchutakunu, eduraaduvaari maata khandinchutakunu shakthigalavaadagunatlu, upadheshamunu anusarinchi nammadagina bodhanu gattigaa chepattukonuvaadunai yundavalenu.

mana rakshakudaina dhevuniyokka dayayu, maanavulayedala aayanakunna premayu pratyakshamainappudu

nityajeevamunugoorchina nireekshananu batti daaniki vaarasulamagutakai aa parishuddhaatmanu mana rakshakudaina yesukreesthu dvaaraa aayana manameeda samruddhigaa kummarinchenu.

avivekatharkamulunu vamshaavalulunu kalahamulunu dharmashaastramunugoorchina vivaadamulunu nish‌prayojanamunu vyarthamunai yunnavi ganuka vaatiki dooramugaa undumu.
